Maria G: Deployed libhttp v2.4.1 (CVE-2026-XYZ) to canary this morning — canary id canary-2026-03-18-0423. Seeing p99 jump 220ms -> 480ms on the model inference path. Grafana: https://grafana.local/d/abcd/canary?panel=latency :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for canary-2026-03-18-0423 (image: libhttp:2.4.1)

Jason R: I see it. Error rate steady but tail latency up. Any config changes aside from the lib?

Tom H: Not aware. libhttp change included a new OpenSSL wrapper. That could add blocking crypto. Can you paste flamegraph or top stacks? Quick repro: `wrk -t8 -c100 -d30 http://canary.internal/v1/generate` — run on perf-worker and attach.

Maria G: logs from canary (filtered):
```
[2026-03-18T04:26:11Z] INFO request_id=abc latency=482ms path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-18T04:26:13Z] INFO request_id=def latency=455ms path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-18T04:26:17Z] WARN request_id=ghi downstream=kms timeout=120ms
```

Karen S: KMS note — new lib linked to synchronous crypto calls before sending request. Check audit logs for blocking KMS calls and SDK version. If KMS calls are sync on hot path, that explains tail.

Ali S: Ran a quick histogram query on canary: p99 spikes align with KMS call latency bursts. Loki: https://loki.local/queries?from=... :thumbsup:

Sasha D: Run the post-patch smoke harness: `scripts/postpatch_smoke.sh --target canary-2026-03-18-0423 --samples 100` — it runs perf + correctness. I started it and uploaded run: https://artifacts.local/patch-smoke/1776543210

Tom H: Plan: (1) toggle KMS async mode on canary if available, (2) fallback route model variants for 10% traffic, (3) rollback libhttp if toggle doesn't help. @oncall please approve limited rollback if needed.

Maria G: I'll toggle async KMS and monitor for 10m. If p99 stays >350ms after 10m we rollback. Assigning: Maria (toggle + monitor), Tom (prepare rollback image), Ali (observe metrics), Sasha (validate smoke). :ok_hand:

deploy-bot: Canary canary-2026-03-18-0423 config updated: kms_mode=async

Maria G: Monitoring — p99 dropped to ~240ms after toggle. Keeping watch for 20m. Thanks all. :relieved:
